messages:
maria: heads-up — after the int8 quant pass for aegis-pro-v2, our locale regression suite flagged token alignment issues for mixed CJK+Latin inputs and an odd ASCII-fallback insertion. example: input='中华人民共和国and China' tokenized -> ['中华', '人民', '共和', '国', 'and', ' ', 'China'] which is wrong (extra separate space token and ascii fallback). @ken any idea? :thinking:
ken: can you paste the exact failing example + the eval-bot log?
maria: pasted below. small batch from locale-suite (ja/zh -> en).

maria: ```
INPUT: "我爱中华人民共和国 and its history."
TOKENIZER OUT: ["我", "爱", "中华", "人民", "共和", "国", " ", "and", " ", "its", "history", "."]
GOLD TOKENS: ["我", "爱", "中华人民共和国", "and", "its", "history", "."]
BLEU DIFF (baseline -> quant-int8): -0.87 (ja->en testset)
```

eval-bot: automated_run: id=run-789, model=aegis-pro-v2-int8, dataset=locale-suite-v4, metrics={bleu:-0.87, chrF:-0.03}, note: ascii-fallback-count=42, mixedscript-mismatch=16

priya: is this coming from the tokenizer change or the quantized embedding table? we rolled a kernel tweak yesterday that touched the embedding packing path on staging.
tom: reminder — our int8 path uses per-channel quant + asymmetric zero-point. small zero-point shifts can change token id collisions in the embedding lookup if tokenizer merges split differently.
ken: initial guess: tokenizer fallback table (ascii fallback rule) is being triggered by an off-by-one in byte offsets after token boundaries; could be normalization step skipped. try forcing unicode-normalize NFKC in preproc to see if the fallback disappears.
maria: quick test: forced NFKC -> ascii-fallback-count reduced to 3, BLEU delta improved to -0.25 but still negative. so normalization helps but doesn't fully fix.
ken: ok that suggests two issues: 1) preprocessing normalization (easy patch), 2) embedding table alignment after quant/shard (harder). I'll start a bisect on the quant artifacts to see when token ids started shifting.

maria: running bisect now across quantization commits (quant-lib v0.9.1 -> v0.9.4). sharing link to artifact bundle: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/aegis-pro-v2/int8/bisect/ (internal)

eval-bot: latest bisect snapshot: suspect-change=commit f3a9c2 (embedding pack reorder), p-value=0.002, repro-run: https://ci.redwood/infer/bisect/1738887777

priya: i'll freeze the new 8-bit kernel on staging and revert f3a9c2 on canary until we triage. :lock:
tom: if ken's embedding alignment fix is invasive, we can first add a low-risk tokenizer normalization transform to devex pipeline to mitigate customer impact while we patch the runtime.
ken: agreed — I'll prototype an embedding-offset-check in the model loader that warns when token id distributions shift >1% relative to fp16 baseline. also adding a unit test in locale-suite that includes mixed CJK+latin sentences to catch regressions early.
maria: assigning follow-ups: ken (triage + detector), priya (freeze/revert on staging), tom (preproc normalization patch + patch release note), i'll continue bisect and attach failing examples to the ticket.
ken: got it. will post updates here by EOD. :white_check_mark:
priya: uploaded kernel revert PR: https://git.internal/reverts/1223 (staging only).
maria: thanks all. tagging @support if any customer hits this in prod.
summary: int8 quantization caused CJK+Latin token alignment issues; short-term mitigation: unicode normalization, staging kernel freeze; long-term: embedding alignment fix and unit tests
